sourceAuthentication.details: Dev01 copies the final M923 registry-entry values as fixed code constants. A supplied sourceId, record, caller expectedPins, mutable JSON manifest or recomputed hash never creates a capability.

Read approved records and policy plus fixed M921 data evidence and eight original data resources; reject missing, different, duplicate or unlisted resources. Archived 27 scripts are data evidence only, never executed.

From the fixed original gzip select exact global entry, heteronym and definition. Compare complete entry, source word, pinyin, inferred tone, POS, definition, example/quote/link and hashes to each decision. Do not trust selected coordinates or a local subset alone.

Verify actual fixed dataset and SQLite pack, complete baseline record/readings/default selected reading. Replay same-codepoint or both fixed Unicode variant directions; compare glyph proof and hashes. No new element/radical/semantic tags granted.

Compare M910/M914 selections/subsets/source locks, M916 rows, M917 rows, M921 lineage/records/proposals to exact M923 per-row hashes. 37 text values unchanged, only the three approved proposal strings adopted. Historical 38/2 and 川 hold remain as old evidence.

Read fixed source license/notices, preserve original dictionary entries and attribution; compare exact labels. Keep M923 project wording separate and projectWish null. Never replace source licensing with project CC0.

Only the successful fixed main loader stores the actual object in a non-exported WeakMap with family/version/resource pins. Serialized, cloned, forged, pure-domain-created and other-family handles all fail. Refresh reauthenticates this family and invalidates stale capability.

context.canonicalization: M923-C14N-1 recursive lexicographic object-key sorting; array order retained; JSON primitives only; UTF8 JSON without BOM/newline; no Unicode or spelling normalization
context.themeIds: explicit exact known IDs, no duplicates, lexical sorted before context serialization
context.position: 0-based Unicode codepoint index in givenName; surname prefix checked separately; no surname adoption
context.stageNotHashed: stage alone never changes eligibility; save/restore validates the originally issued context and receipt

hashBindings.baseDatasetSHA256: record.identity.baseDatasetSha256; verified actual original file bytes
hashBindings.basePackSHA256: record.identity.basePackSha256; verified actual original file bytes
hashBindings.projectTextSHA256: record.projectTextSHA256 = SHA256(UTF8(exact new project.meaning string)); no newline
hashBindings.projectSHA256: record.projectSHA256 = SHA256(UTF8(JSON.stringify(new M923 record.project object))); preserve stored field order
hashBindings.otherObjectHashRule: M921 historical object hashes preserve original parsed field order with JSON.stringify; do not apply C14N to them

receipt.validation: No authority in the receipt itself. Main resolves its exact registered family/version then recomputes every field from fixed resources and full saved candidate/context/constraints. Missing/extra/tampered fields or cross-family substitution reject before eligibility. A valid older M752 receipt is only handled by its original exact legacy branch.
receipt.equivalentCanonicalReconstruction: A completely equivalent reconstructed receipt may satisfy deterministic integrity verification; this is not proof of a past issuer event, a signature or an authorization capability. Actual producer/store path is proved only by runtime tests. Source authority always comes from private main registration.
receipt.archivalReplay: Absent new receipt in legacy history remains absent. A saved valid M923 session retains its saved explicit selection; current preference off does not erase it. Recompute only to verify saved version, never migrate outputs. Changed request is a new generation requiring new opt-in.

coverage.eligibleForOptInRequest: compute distinct eligible char+reading+sense occurrences with true active constraints; report separately from default coverage

approvalSemantics: This is a new reusable approval of the exact forty character-level project meanings. Implementing the pinned new family and opt-in gates needs runtime acceptance, not another semantic hold or per-future-name manual approval. No inferred full-name/personality/fate/element/score authority.
